title: Nittobo expands glass cloth output as AI chip demand strains global supply
source_used: DigiTimes (headline and opening line only; the page is paywalled)
key_facts: DigiTimes (opening line of a paywalled article, 6 Oct 2026): Nittobo is expanding production of its T-Glass glass cloth as demand from AI chip makers tightens a critical part of the global semiconductor supply chain.

Background (TrendForce, 6 Aug 2026, not today's article): Nittobo is a Japanese maker of T-glass, a glass material used in AI chip packaging; it planned to reach three times its fiscal 2025 T-glass capacity by the fiscal year ending March 2029.
quote_evidence: Nittobo is expanding production of its T-Glass glass cloth as demand from AI chip makers tightens a critical part of the global semiconductor supply chain
why_it_matters_hint: A tight supply of a glass cloth used in AI chip packaging is a pinch point for chip makers.
notes: Headline only: DigiTimes is paywalled, only the headline and a one-sentence teaser were visible, and no other outlet carried today's expansion (Google News search found only DigiTimes). Size and timing of the expansion unknown. Background, not today's news: TrendForce (6 Aug 2026), citing Nikkei, said Nittobo planned to reach three times its fiscal 2025 T-glass capacity by the fiscal year ending March 2029, that its president said 'even this expansion will not be enough', and that T-glass is used in AI chip packaging.
